name: blueprint/fx-ledger
description: Multi-currency expense ledger over keyless rates: frankfurter.app supplies daily ECB rates, the budget-guard scan sums, the store converts
recipe: fetch the daily rate -> store rate:<date> -> sum expenses per currency by prefix scan -> convert to the base currency and store the converted total
pitfalls: rates are dated - store the date with the rate
the scan-and-sum is the query (budget-guard learnings)
frankfurter is keyless but probe it first
the cap stays in the store, not settings (schema wall)
